plain: Seeming right or true at first look, but actually false

more.text: Apparently right; superficially fair, just or correct; plausible; appearing well at first view; as specious reasoning; a specious argument; a specious objection; specious deeds.

example.quote: This argument presents itself under a very specious and seducing form; and is well calculated to lay hold of the prejudices of those to whom it is addressed.
